features.name: AUTOMATION_ENGINE

features.name: CONWAY_CELLULAR_AUTOMATON
features.evidence: Deterministic Conway Game of Life engine includes oscillator tests.

features.name: SAIC_UNCAPPED_SUPPLY_LEDGER
features.evidence: Native Solana program stores authority-controlled minted supply with no configured cap, pause control, checked arithmetic, and fail-closed authority checks.
features.limitation: This is an on-chain supply ledger, not an SPL Token mint.

features.name: LAUNCHPAD_CORE
features.evidence: Validated launch registry plus authority-controlled Solana launch state exist.
features.limitation: No claim of a production token sale, liquidity pool, or SPL mint until those on-chain integrations are implemented and deployed.

features.name: WEB4_LABEL

features.limitation: Web 4.0 is not treated as a formal Solana protocol or certification.
